column1: # Team / Faction / Difficulty / Controller: enum-style value types whose constructor tuples are
# visible in the rulesets and in the enum constants itself:
#   Team("TeamA[i18n]: Team A", "TEAM_A") -> getName / getKey ; the static lookup matches on the
#   Faction(id, "USA[i18n]: USA", "USA") -> getId / getName / getKey ; FactionList searches by the
#   Controller("AI[i18n]: AI", Difficulty.Casual) -> the difficulty accessor is getDifficulty and
#   the static lookup is the inverse mapping -> fromDifficulty.
# UnitGroup / UnitGroupSet: a squad slot (id + members) and the fixed-size set of them; UnitGroupSet
#   builds one group per index in its constructor, so get(int)/size() are the natural accessors and
#   the duplicate b(int) (same body as a(int)) is named getGroup to keep it distinct.
# PlayerList: a = alive player count -> countAlive ; b = whether the first player has a team
#   -> hasTeams ; c = number of distinct teams among the alive players (bitmask over Team.ordinal)
#   -> countAliveTeams ; d = teams when there are teams, otherwise players, i.e. the number of
#   competing sides -> countActiveSides ; a(int) looks a player up by id -> getById.
